sources.entry: Noosfero - Platform for social and solidarity economy networks with blog, e-Portfolios, CMS, RSS, thematic discussion, events agenda and collective intelligence for solidarity economy in the same system. AGPL-3.0 Ruby

summary.name: Noosfero
summary.one_liner: Noosfero is a web-based social networking platform, written in Ruby and licensed under AGPL-3.0, for social and solidarity economy networks.
use_cases: running a social network for solidarity economy groups
hosting multiple sites from one installation
summary.what_it_does: Per the awesome-selfhosted listing, Noosfero combines a blog, e-portfolios, a CMS, RSS, thematic discussion, an events agenda and collective intelligence features in one system aimed at social and solidarity economy networks. The GitLab page itself is a repository landing page listing documentation files: install guides for the core app, multitenancy (multiple sites), Varnish HTTP caching, an awstats access statistics service, a chat service and an email service. It also points to development, hacking and release docs, plus a Telegram group for the developer community. The page does not describe features in detail.
notable: Supports multiple sites from one installation (multitenancy)
Bundles blog, e-portfolio, CMS, RSS and events agenda in one system
Optional Varnish caching and awstats statistics services
caveats: The page text does not describe end-user features beyond the awesome-selfhosted listing summary
Installation requires separate setup guides for optional services such as chat and email
